title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Did you ever get your wife flowers? Is she back?
Flowers yes. But after 35 years there is much more to a relationship. You will find out. I can be your mentor. I am a romantic at heart.
Check out this article from Detroit Free Press: Manager's experience, leadership more important than analytics savvy
You did good. I think you are really getting it.
I think you can be better than the Dick Heads just trying to get the next headline

I just saw The Detroit News article that the Vegas odds are we have the worst odds of winning next year and Houston and LA have the best odds. Really, what value is there on reporting that. Especially at this time. Anyone from elementary school could have stated that.
